scenario_summary: Customer is reporting an unrecognized charge of $76 and requesting an investigation and potential refund.

conversation.message: Hi, my name is DeShawn Jefferson and I'm 85. I noticed a $76 charge on my account from two days ago that I don't recognize. I haven't made any recent purchases that I can think of, though it's possible I forgot about something small. Can you look into it, and if it turns out I really didn't authorize it, can you refund it?

Hello, Mr. Jefferson. I would be happy to help you look into that charge today. To ensure your account security, could you please confirm the email address associated with your account and the last four digits of the card used for this transaction?
Sure, my email is djefferson85@email.com, and the card ends in 4492.

Thank you for that information. I have located the transaction. It is listed as 'Global Market Services' for $76.00 on October 12th. Does that merchant name sound familiar at all, perhaps for a subscription or a service?
No, that doesn't sound familiar at all. I don't have any subscriptions that cost that much.

I understand. Per our security policy for unauthorized transactions, I have initiated a formal dispute for this charge. I have also placed a temporary freeze on your card ending in 4492 to prevent any further unauthorized activity while we investigate.
Oh, that sounds serious. Does that mean I'll get my money back?

Yes, Mr. Jefferson. I have issued a provisional credit of $76.00 to your account, which will appear within 24 hours. Our fraud department will complete the investigation within 10 business days. You will receive a confirmation email shortly with your case reference number: #99283-DX.

resolution_summary: Agent verified the customer, identified the unauthorized transaction, initiated a dispute, placed a security freeze on the card, and issued a provisional credit.
